newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather-Light showers seen over parts of S.Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather-Light showers seen over parts of S.Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department on Thursday forecast light showers in the Central, Sabaragamuwa and Western provinces and over Galle and Matara districts for Friday.

It said in a statement that thunder showers would develop at a few places in the Uva, Eastern and northcentral provinces during Friday afternoon or evening. Gusts of fairly strong westerly winds would continue to prevail along the western slopes of the central hills and elsewhere during showers.
